<!-- lemma-1: body_md -->
Let $t\in F_2^n$. Then
\[
\oplus_{i=1}^n t_i\equiv \sum_{i=1}^n t_i+2\sum_{1\le i<j\le n} t_it_j \ (mod \ 4).
\]
<!-- end lemma-1 -->
<!-- proposition-1: body_md -->
If $NLB_8=118$, then there exists a balanced $g\in B_8$ of nonlinearity 118 satisfying $\oplus_{x\in supp(g)} x=e_8$ and
\begin{equation}
W_g(a,c)\equiv 4c+8Q(a)\ (mod\ 16),
\end{equation}
for any $(a,c)\in F_2^7\times F_2$, where $Q(a)\in B_7$ is a quadratic function with $Q(0)=0$.
<!-- end proposition-1 -->
<!-- lemma-2: body_md -->
Let $f\in B_n$ be quadratic with $f(0)=0$ and polar rank $2r$. Then $|W_f(\omega)|$ is supported on an affine subspace of size $2^{2r}$, and all its nonzero values have magnitude $2^{n-r}$. Therefore,
\[
wt(f)\in \{2^{n-1},2^{n-1}-2^{n-r-1},2^{n-1}+2^{n-r-1}\}.
\]
If $r=0$, then $wt(f)\in \{0, 2^{n-1}\}$.
<!-- end lemma-2 -->
<!-- lemma-3: body_md -->
We have
\begin{equation}
(W_g(a,1), (-1)^{Q(a)})=256+32(h_0+h_1)+24wt(Q).
\end{equation}
<!-- end lemma-3 -->
<!-- proposition-2: body_md -->
The polar rank of $Q$ is 6.
<!-- end proposition-2 -->
<!-- lemma-4: body_md -->
Let $z$ and $w$ be defined as above. Then
\begin{equation}
|supp(v_R)|\le 4+\frac{3}{2}z+5w.
\end{equation}
<!-- end lemma-4 -->
<!-- proposition-3: body_md -->
We have $wt(Q)=56$.
<!-- end proposition-3 -->
<!-- lemma-5: body_md -->
If $z\in\{4,6\}$, then
\[
|\{a\in F_2^6: p(a)=0, H_6u_L(a) =\pm4\}|\ge 6.
\]
<!-- end lemma-5 -->
<!-- proposition-4: body_md -->
$z$ must be zero.
<!-- end proposition-4 -->
<!-- lemma-6: body_md -->
Let $f_1,f_2\in B_6$, where $f_1$ is a bent function. If $d(f_1,f_2)\in\{4,5,6\}$, then $nl(f_2)\le26$.
<!-- end lemma-6 -->
<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
The maximum nonlinearity of 8-variable balanced Boolean functions is 116.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- open-problem-1: body_md -->
Does there exist a 9-variable balanced Boolean function with nonlinearity 242?
<!-- end open-problem-1 -->
<!-- open-problem-2: body_md -->
Determine the covering radius of RM(1,9).
<!-- end open-problem-2 -->
<!-- open-problem-3: body_md -->
Does there exist a 10-variable balanced Boolean function with nonlinearity 494?
<!-- end open-problem-3 -->
<!-- open-problem-4: body_md -->
Let $f\in B_{2n}$ be balanced. Do we have $nl(f)\le 2^{2n-1}-2^{n-1}-4$ for any $n\ge 4$?
<!-- end open-problem-4 -->
